situations.title: 노인 낙상 후 문진
situations.tagline: I just slipped, that's all. No need to make a fuss.
situations.brief: 낙상 정황·실신 여부·복용약을 차분히 문진하며 축소 진술을 살피세요.
keyPhrases: Do you remember feeling dizzy or faint before you fell?
Did you lose consciousness at any point?
Let's go over the medications you take.

situations.title: 다약제 복용력 정리
situations.tagline: Oh, I take quite a few pills — I can't remember all of them.
situations.brief: 처방·비처방 약을 목록화하며 노인의 기억을 인내심 있게 도우세요.
keyPhrases: Do you have a list or the bottles with you?
Let's include vitamins and anything you buy over the counter.
Take your time — we'll go one by one.

situations.title: 청력저하 환자 소통
situations.tagline: Speak up, dear — I can't hear a thing you're saying.
situations.brief: 정면·저음·서면을 활용해 청력저하 환자와 명확히 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll face you and speak slowly — let me know if this is clearer.
Would it help if I wrote this down for you?
Just raise your hand if you miss something.

situations.title: 기저 인지기능 확인
situations.tagline: My mother is usually sharp, but today she seems off.
situations.brief: 평소 지남력과 인지 기저선을 보호자에게서 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: What is she normally like on a good day?
When did you first notice this change?
Your observations help us a lot — thank you.

situations.title: 활동·일상수행 청취
situations.tagline: I used to do everything myself, but lately it's gotten harder.
situations.brief: ADL을 기반으로 기능 상태와 최근 변화를 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: Are you able to bathe and dress on your own?
Has anything changed in what you can do lately?
There's no shame in needing a little help.

situations.title: 급성 섬망 감별
situations.tagline: Who are you? Where am I? I want to go home right now.
situations.brief: 치매와 구분되는 급성 인지 변화를 감별하며 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: You're in the hospital and you're safe with me.
This confusion may be new — we're finding out why.
I'm going to stay close and help you feel calmer.

situations.title: 비전형 감염 표현
situations.tagline: She has no fever, but she's confused and just not eating.
situations.brief: 발열 없는 UTI·폐렴 등 비전형 감염 표현을 보호자 정보로 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: In older adults, infections can show up as confusion, not fever.
Has she had any changes in urination or breathing?
We'll run tests to find a hidden infection.

situations.title: 노인 흉통 비전형
situations.tagline: It's not really pain, just a heavy, tired feeling in my chest.
situations.brief: 무증상·비특이 MI 가능성을 놓치지 않도록 비전형 흉통을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Even without sharp pain, we take this seriously.
Do you feel more tired or short of breath than usual?
We'll check your heart to be safe.

situations.title: 다약제 상호작용 부작용
situations.tagline: Ever since the new pill, I've felt dizzy and fallen twice.
situations.brief: 약물 상호작용이 유발한 낙상·혼돈을 사정하고 복약을 재검토하세요.
keyPhrases: When did the dizziness start after the new medication?
Some medicines can interact and cause these symptoms.
We'll review everything you take to find the cause.

situations.title: 요양시설 이송 정보 부족
situations.tagline: The transfer papers don't say much — I hope you can figure it out.
situations.brief: 불완전한 인계 정보를 보완하기 위해 이송 요원과 보호자에게서 정보를 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you know her baseline and what happened today?
Can you help me reach the facility for her records?
Any medication or allergy info you can share?

situations.title: 학대·방임 의심
situations.tagline: I'm fine... I don't want to cause any trouble for anyone.
situations.brief: 영양불량·상처를 비대립적으로 청취하며 노인의 안전을 살피세요.
keyPhrases: I noticed some things I'd like to understand better.
You're safe to talk with me — nothing leaves this room without your say.
My only goal is to make sure you're cared for.

situations.title: 진통제 신중 투여
situations.tagline: My hip is killing me, but I'm scared the medicine will knock me out.
situations.brief: 신기능과 낙상 위험을 고려해 진통제를 신중히 설명하고 투여하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll start low and adjust carefully for your kidneys.
I'll help you avoid feeling too groggy or unsteady.
Tell me if you feel dizzy at any point.

situations.title: 보청기·안경 보조기구
situations.tagline: I left my hearing aids at home — everything feels so confusing here.
situations.brief: 감각 보조기구를 확보해 지남력과 소통을 개선하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's see if we can get you some help hearing and seeing better.
I'll speak clearly and stay in your view.
Having your glasses will help you feel less confused.

situations.title: 사전연명의료의향 확인
situations.tagline: Dad always said he never wanted to be kept alive on machines.
situations.brief: POLST/DNR 등 사전의향을 가족과 함께 존중적으로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Do you know if he has a POLST or advance directive?
What matters most to him about his care?
We'll honor his wishes as best we can.

situations.title: 노인 패혈증 급속 진행
situations.tagline: She's so cold and weak — this came on out of nowhere.
situations.brief: 저체온·저혈압 등 비전형 패혈증을 인지해 신속히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Her low temperature and pressure worry me — we're acting fast.
In older adults sepsis can look different, and we're on it.
We're starting treatment right away.

situations.title: 항응고제 두부외상
situations.tagline: It was just a little bump on the head — but she's on blood thinners.
situations.brief: 경미한 낙상이라도 항응고제 복용 시 뇌출혈 위험을 신속히 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Because she's on blood thinners, we take head bumps seriously.
We'll get a scan right away to rule out bleeding.
Watch for any drowsiness or confusion — tell me immediately.
goals: 항응고제 복용 하 두부외상 위험을 평가한다

situations.title: 급성 섬망+공격성
situations.tagline: Get your hands off me! I don't know any of you people!
situations.brief: 공격성을 유발한 섬망의 원인을 규명하며 진정을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: You're safe here — I'm not going to hurt you.
Something's causing this confusion and we're finding it.
Let's lower the noise so you feel calmer.

situations.title: 말기 환자 목표 재설정
situations.tagline: We don't want him to suffer anymore — what are our options?
situations.brief: 완화 중심의 치료 목표를 가족 회의로 존중적으로 재설정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's talk about what would give him the most comfort.
There's no wrong choice here — we'll support whatever you decide.
Comfort care is an active, caring option too.

situations.title: 다발성 만성질환 급성 악화
situations.tagline: My legs are swollen and I can't catch my breath lying down.
situations.brief: 심부전·신부전 복합 악화를 사정하며 우선순위를 정해 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Your heart and kidneys are both under strain — we're balancing them.
We'll help your breathing first and go from there.
Tell me which symptom is bothering you most.

situations.title: 고관절 골절 통증·수술 대기
situations.tagline: The pain is unbearable, and now they say I have to wait for surgery.
situations.brief: 통증을 조절하고 대기 중 섬망을 예방하며 수술을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll manage your pain while you wait for surgery.
Staying oriented and hydrated helps prevent confusion.
I'll keep checking on you so you're not alone.

situations.title: 요양원 이송 임종 임박
situations.tagline: We just want her last moments to be peaceful, surrounded by us.
situations.brief: 편안한 죽음을 지원하며 가족의 임종 준비를 동반하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll focus on keeping her comfortable and peaceful.
You can hold her hand and speak to her — she may still hear you.
Take all the time you need; we're here for all of you.
